title: The Foundry
summary: Cinder, where every probe was made. The print hall (three cradles, our shape worn into the first: three-cradles), the launch rail (one launch instant, voyage logs loaded at the foot: the-rail), and the Director's booth on the western bench (three scripts, take one each: director-three, the reveal). Accord-pattern guards in white (faction foundry). Sets foundry-found (the Clause wakes sooner: clause-6), routes Teth, then home, where the Clause wakes (clause-wakes follows this mission).

objectives.text: Reach the print hall on the high terrace
Find the booth on the western bench

notes: after: first-light, because the gate is the route: cinder-foundry is only routed once two threads are done (foundry-lead-kd / -kl / -dl), and a mission with a region starts once its region is routed. clause-wakes follows this mission (id fixed by the climax).
